name: dt_day
label: Day of the week for date of application use

name: dt_wknd
label: Whether date of application use was on a weekend day (Sat/Sun) or not

name: dtt_screenshot
label: Date/time when screenshot of this page of the Screen Time report was taken

name: app
label: Application ID; in the case of web usage, the application ID for the corresponding application is used

name: n_pickups
label: Number of pickups that were followed by using this application or website

name: min_usage
label: Duration this application or website was used (in minutes, rounded to the nearest minute, or rounded up to 1 minute for nonzero durations <60 sec). Note that browser usage includes the usage of specific websites
